about: South Frontenac Township is a rural municipality north of Kingston in Frontenac County, Ontario, covering lake and forest country toward Sydenham, Inverary, and Verona. Canadian Shield shores, cottage lakes, and farmland replace any single urban core. Highway 38 and county roads link villages to Kingston. About 20,000 people live in South Frontenac Township.
seoSummary: Frontenac County township of Sydenham, Inverary, and Verona—Shield lakes and villages north of Kingston, not a city.
